# AgentOps Monitor - Complete System Context & Documentation (agentopsmonitor.com)
> Observability, telemetry, distributed tracing, and security monitoring for multi-agent systems and LLM pipelines.

This document contains comprehensive architecture, technical specifications, and API documentation for LLMs, AI agents, and automated crawlers querying AgentOps Monitor.

---

## 1. Platform Overview
AgentOps Monitor (https://agentopsmonitor.com) is an observability and reliability platform engineered specifically for autonomous agent networks, multi-agent frameworks, and complex LLM architectures.

### Core Problems Solved
- Invisible Cascading Failures: Multi-agent loops where subagents hallucinate or get stuck in recursive execution cycles.
- Token Runaways and Budget Exhaustion: Unchecked tool calls causing sudden cost spikes across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or local models.
- Tool Call Failures: Silent errors in API calls, malformed parameters, or unhandled exceptions in agent toolchains.
- Security and Policy Breaches: Prompt injection, unauthorized data exfiltration, and tool execution outside defined boundary policies.

---

## 2. Core Architecture & Features

### 2.1 Distributed Multi-Agent Tracing
- JSON ingest over HTTPS. An OpenTelemetry collector is planned; OTLP compatibility is not available today.
- Run detail view listing spans with type, status, timing, tokens, and cost, with parent and child span ids.

### 2.2 Cost and Token Analytics
- Input and output token counts per run and per span, recorded as sent by the client at ingest.
- Cost per run and per span, recorded as sent by the client at ingest.
- Spend limits are not enforced at ingest. A per-run cost cap is planned.

### 2.3 Agent Security Guardrails
Not implemented. There is no prompt-injection scanner, no tool authorization policy engine, and no anomaly detection or killswitch logic in this product today.

### 2.4 Integration Surface
AgentOps Monitor ingests through one authenticated HTTPS endpoint, so any language or framework can post traces without a vendor SDK:
- Python: `requests` or `urllib`
- Node.js / TypeScript: `fetch` or any HTTP client
- Framework adapters (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI, Anthropic): wrap the same POST call around your agent loop.

---

## 3. Quick Start & Integration Guides

### Python Integration
```python
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://agentopsmonitor.com/api/ingest",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer aom_live_..."},
    json={
        "external_id": "run-001",
        "agent_name": "customer-support-swarm",
        "status": "completed",
        "tokens_in": 412880,
        "tokens_out": 88104,
        "cost_usd": 18.44,
        "spans": [
            {"span_type": "workflow", "tool_name": "start", "duration_ms": 0},
            {"span_type": "llm", "provider": "openai", "model": "gpt-4o",
             "tool_name": "openai.chat", "tokens_in": 8204, "tokens_out": 512,
             "cost_usd": 0.08, "duration_ms": 600},
            {"span_type": "tool", "provider": "stripe",
             "tool_name": "stripe.refunds.create", "status": "held", "duration_ms": 208},
        ],
    },
)
# 200 -> {"ok": true, "run_id": "<uuid>", "span_count": 3}
```

### TypeScript / Node.js Integration
```typescript
const response = await fetch("https://agentopsmonitor.com/api/ingest", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: "Bearer aom_live_...",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    external_id: "sess-98213",
    agent_name: "analyst-01",
    status: "completed",
    spans: [
      { span_type: "llm", provider: "anthropic", model: "claude-sonnet-4-5",
        tool_name: "anthropic.messages", tokens_in: 4200, tokens_out: 610,
        cost_usd: 0.02, duration_ms: 900 },
    ],
  }),
});
const result = await response.json(); // { ok, run_id, span_count }
```

---

## 4. REST API Reference

All requests to the ingestion API require the `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` header.

### Endpoints
- `POST https://agentopsmonitor.com/api/ingest`
  - Ingest a run: JSON body with `external_id`, `agent_name`, optional token/cost fields, and a `spans` array (each span has `span_type` of `llm`, `tool`, or `workflow`, plus optional `provider`, `model`, `tool_name`, `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `cost_usd`, `duration_ms`, `status`, `input`, `output`).
  - Auth: `Authorization: Bearer aom_live_...` (401 without a valid key).
  - Errors: 400 invalid JSON or schema, 413 body over 1 MB, 429 rate limit exceeded.
  - 200 response: `{ "ok": true, "run_id": "<uuid>", "span_count": <n> }`.
- `GET https://agentopsmonitor.com/api/health`
  - Returns service liveness and the deployed build SHA. No uptime history is recorded.

---

## 5. Pricing and Plans

**One quota is enforced: the Free-tier monthly run cap.** `plans.included_runs` for the free
plan (10,000) is checked inside the ingest transaction, and an over-limit request is rejected
with HTTP 402 `quota_exceeded` plus `runs_used` and `runs_included`. The check fails open: if
the plan lookup errors, ingest continues. Nothing else is enforced. `plans.overage_per_1k` is
still read by no billing code, so no overage is metered or charged and the Team tier keeps
ingesting past its published 500,000 figure rather than being cut off. Metered overage
billing is on the roadmap.

### Developer (Free)
- $0 / month
- 10,000 runs per month, enforced at ingest (HTTP 402 when exceeded)
- Community support

### Pro (Team)
- $299 / month
- 500,000 runs is published intent, not a hard limit: no cap is enforced and no overage is charged
- A per-run cost cap is planned. Cost alerts are not implemented.

### Enterprise
- Contact us for pricing.
